entry.description: Qwen3.6 35B A3B: a mixture-of-experts multimodal model with reasoning, tool calling and structured outputs, at its full 262K context.

how_to_reconcile: counted_usd is the sum of the per-attempt figures above: listed prices times reported tokens, the provider's own cost field where it was higher, one worst-case call for every attempt without complete usage. The provider's bill may be lower, never higher if it bills what its usage says; a bill above counted_usd by more than 10 percent + $0.05 means the count is wrong: stop accepting requests.
